chunks: And there is not one among the People of the Book who will not believe in it before his death; and on the Day of Resurrection he will be a witness over them.
ai.seo_question: Who believes in Prophet Muhammad before death according to Surah An-Nisa verse 159?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'before his death' (qabla mawtihi) is interpreted by many scholars as referring to the death of the individual, meaning every Jew and Christian will ultimately accept Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Imams before their own demise, either in the grave or at the moment of death. This universal acceptance serves as a divine testimony against them on the Day of Resurrection, highlighting that their rejection was a conscious choice despite the eventual clarity of the truth. The verse underscores the inevitability of the finality of prophethood and the accountability of those who knew the truth but concealed it.
